$comment: Global balance numbers. Every value here can be tuned without touching engine code.

levies.$comment: Men who can be called per thousand people: the recruiting context's fighting-age share (0.25) times the farmers' call share (0.12).

march.$comment: Marching and feeding armies, after the warfare design (sections 5 and 6) and the province design (section 3.1). One crossing unit in the design's days-to-cross table is daysPerCrossing real days here, since a province on this map is about 100 km and a 1444 army marched 15-20 km a day.

war.$comment: Milestone 1, war and conquest. Battles, sieges and peace use the warfare and diplomacy contexts' own numbers; these only fit them to the weekly turn.

recruit.$comment: Milestone 2, armies that cost something. Pay, training costs, the levy and the troop cap come from domain/recruiting.json and domain/warfare.json; these fit them to this game's economy and weekly turn. goldScale turns the domain's gold into the treasury's gold (one domain gold is 0.004 here).
